evidence: The southern end of the Old Ghost Road starts at the Lyell Conservation Campsite (State Highway 6) in the Upper Buller Gorge, a 50 minute drive from Westport.
The northern end of the Old Ghost Road finishes at Seddonville, 50 km north of Westport on State Highway 67.
The old miners' road is rejoined for the virtually flat journey out to Seddonville through the spectacular Mokihinui River gorge.

doubts: The Seddonville end is given as F2 (where The Old Ghost Road meets Mokihinui Road), taken to be the trail's northern road end; the Seddonville place point is some km further west, and the text only says the trail 'finishes at Seddonville'. The Lyell start has no road-end feature, so the Lyell Campsite (T8) is used as the text says the trail starts there.
